      "observations": [
        "The landing adds a separate false-by-default address-book Account Hub preference, independent of the mail setup preference. It routes address-book tab clicks, app-menu and shared addNewAddressBook into ADDRESS_BOOK while preserving legacy fallbacks. addNewAddressBook still ignores its requested JS/LDAP/CARDDAV type in the Hub branch and records a TODO; it does not implement those creation flows in this landing. Fixed default is later true.",
        "The original new view is a29-line placeholder with an empty template and reset method. Controller loads the module before the custom element, so the reported missing-reset-method issue is addressed at that interface boundary; no complete address-book setup UI is implemented here. Current view has later substantial state/ready/reset behavior, only its relevant hooks checked. Controller reset still tests the returned value synchronously, so async reset completion is not established by that guard.",
        "The app menu uses separate submenu and direct-open items, updates hidden states on pref change and initializes them explicitly. Reviewer retracts a single-handler proposal after remembering the submenu; a bare lazy-property access proposal was tried and reported ineffective. Neither becomes a general lazy getter or menu rule.",
        "Address-book content invokes browsingContext.topChromeWindow, while the chrome overlay uses its own window. Reviewer parent/recent-window proposals are qualified by actual tab and removed read-message-menu cases. Existing pane button/route knowledge is reused; no universal most-recent-window rule or keyboard result is inferred.",
        "The two new tests open via app menu and address-book tab, await dialog existence/open and Escape close, then restore prefs/close the opened tab. Their address-book helper branch is a TODO and does not wait/assert the address-book view. Fixed helper now maps ADDRESS_BOOK to address-book-option-select and waits its existence/visibility. This stronger later check is not retroactive coverage of the placeholder landing.",
        "Reviewer asks for task-local or registered cleanup if a task does not run. Author rebuts that only the last task opens the tab; final source closes it in that task. This scoped exchange does not reverse deliberate cleanup guidance. Label plural/Fluent empty-line comments remain local; stale skip comments are removed when Escape-enabled tests run."
